cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.f1.desc: Copies the movement of the clicked part onto its pair on the other side, mirrored left/right (optionally delayed)
cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.f2.desc: Makes a new animation with the whole movement mirrored left/right (left and right parts swap)
cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.f6.desc: Moves the movement of the selected parts later or earlier inside the animation (loops wrap around)
cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.f7mirror: Mirror pose to the other side
cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.f7mirror.desc: Copies the pose of the selected parts at the playhead to their pair, mirrored
cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.f7reset.desc: Adds keys at the playhead that put the selected parts back to their rest pose
cpmplus.w2animcore.menu.d6.desc: Find and replace in the names of the selected folders / cubes, number repeated names, swap left/right
cpmplus.w2animcore.warn.restNotMirrored: "%s" and "%s" are not mirrored at rest (position or rotation of the parts differ). The mirrored movement may look different on the other side.
cpmplus.w2animcore.warn.molangSkipped: %s keyframe(s) with a formula (Molang) were left out: formulas can't be mirrored.
cpmplus.w2animcore.warn.rotationGlobal: One of the parts uses 'global rotation' in this animation: CPM ignores it, the result may look different in game.
cpmplus.w2animcore.priority.full: No free priority left (255 values in use): change the priority of an animation by hand.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.title: Mirror movement
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.intro: Copies the movement of one part onto another part. With 'Mirror left/right' on, what the left side does the right side does mirrored (great for wings, arms, ears).
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.mirror.desc: On: position X and rotations Y/Z are flipped. Off: plain copy.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.delay.desc: Only for animations that loop. Half a loop = the other side moves alternating (like walking).
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.preview: Will create %s keyframes in %s in %s animation(s).
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.noPart: Choose the part to copy from and the part to paste into.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.samePart: Copy from and paste into are the same part (same part): choose the part on the other side.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.related: "%s" and "%s" are inside each other: one would move the other twice. Choose a part that is not inside the other.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.noChannel: Tick at least one kind of movement (rotation, position...).
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.nothing: "%s" has no keyframes in the chosen channels / animations.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.selectPart: Right-click the part (folder) whose movement you want to copy.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f1.err.noOther: There is no other part to paste into.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.title: Create mirrored copy
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.intro: Makes a copy of the animation with left and right swapped: what the left arm did the right arm does, mirrored. Parts without a side (head, tail) are mirrored in place. The original is not changed.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.name: Name of the copy
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.swap.desc: On: each part's movement goes to its pair. Off: every part is only mirrored in place.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.include: Untick to leave this part unmirrored (in a new copy it keeps its original movement)
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.byOrder: Partner found by its place in the other side's tree (the names differ, e.g. cube114 / cube58).
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.err.duplicate: Two parts go to the same place: %s. Each destination can receive only one part.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.err.staged: "%s" is a stage of another animation (p:/c:/g:): a copy would not be linked to anything. Uncheck 'Create as a new animation' to mirror it in place.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.warn.layerCapacity: The copy is one more layer-controlled animation (%s in total) but this model has room for only %s. The model will not export like this: free more skin layers for animations (the export warning has the fix) or turn off "layer controlled" on one of them.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.warn.headYaw: Head yaw animations keep their type: the head turn values are not reversed by mirroring.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f2.warn.samePose: The copy has the same game pose as the original (for example standing or walking): in game both play together. Use the copy as a starting point and delete one of them, or change the copy's type in its properties.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.title: Delay / advance movement
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.intro: Moves the movement of %s later or earlier in "%s". The animation length does not change.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.hint: Good for hair / cape / tail following the body with a delay. While this window is open the playhead shows the pose the part will have.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.err.noPart: Select the parts (folders) that move in this animation.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.err.zero: The shift is smaller than one step of the timeline (%s s): choose a larger amount.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.err.nothing: The selected parts have no keyframes in the chosen channels.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.warn.dropped: %s keyframe(s) went past the end of the animation and were removed.
cpmplus.w2animcore.f6.warn.noWrap: This animation does not loop: the movement moves without wrapping around (keys that pass the end are removed).
cpmplus.w2animcore.f7.mirror.done: pose of %s part(s) mirrored at %s s
cpmplus.w2animcore.f7.reset.done: %s part(s) back to normal at %s s
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.title: Batch rename
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.intro: Renames the selected folders / cubes at once. Animations, copy transforms and item slots keep working (they don't use names).
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.regex.desc: Advanced: the search is a regular expression; use $1, $2 in 'Replace with' for the groups
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.unique.desc: Repeated names get numbers in outliner order: pena01, pena02...
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.swap.desc: esquerda <-> direita, left <-> right, _l <-> _r, esq <-> dir, _e <-> _d
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.err.regex: The regular expression is not valid: %s
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.err.collision: %s new name(s) are already used by a neighbour (red). Change the text or tick 'Make unique'.
cpmplus.w2animcore.d6.err.noSelection: Select the folders or cubes to rename first.
